name: Chavda Infra Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Chavda Infra Limited provides construction and allied services across residential, commercial, and institutional projects in Gujarat.[1]
keyPoints: Parent Organisation[1] Chavda Infra is a part of the Chavda group, which consists of 3 businesses, Chavda Infra, Chavda RMC, and Chavda Developers, providing services in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, and Rajkot.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.4%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 96.2 to 125 days.
Working capital days have increased from 62.1 days to 89.4 days
